name: Ancient Era
headline: Origins of Mana, Divine Dragons & Mythological Beginnings
description: The primordial epoch before recorded calamity, marked by the world's shaping by Od Laguna, primordial dragons, and the dawn of mortal civilizations.

name: Witch Era
headline: Rise of the Witches of Sin & Primordial Witch Factors
description: An age defined by the rise of the Witches of Sin, devastating authorities, the creation of the Three Great Mabeasts, and the convergence of legends.

name: Great Calamity Era
headline: Satella's Rampage, Fall of Half the World & The Great Sealing
description: The cataclysmic rupture where the Witch of Envy consumed half the world, ending with her sealing at Pleiades Watchtower and the founding covenants.

name: Mystery Era
headline: Rebuilding, Historical Taboos & The Rise of the Witch Cult
description: Centuries cloaked in secrecy and loss of records. Anti-half-elf discrimination spreads while the radicalized Witch Cult forms in the shadows.

name: Old Era
headline: Elior Forest Freeze, Demi-Human Civil War & The Sword Saint
description: A turbulent century defined by the tragedy of Elior Forest, Lugunica's bloody Demi-Human War, and the fall of Theresia van Astrea.

name: Modern Era
headline: Royal Selection Crisis & The Summoning of Natsuki Subaru
description: Emilia awakens, the royal family perishes from sudden illness, and Natsuki Subaru is summoned to Lugunica to challenge fate.
